home.heroTitle: Welcome to the Databricks Well Architected Framework Assessment Tool
home.heroSubtitle: Evaluate your Databricks lakehouse architecture against industry best practices and identify opportunities for optimization across seven critical pillars.
home.aboutText: The Databricks Well Architected Framework (WAF) provides comprehensive guidance for implementing a data lakehouse on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. It helps organizations build safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective data and AI solutions through structured assessments and continuous improvement cycles.
home.pillarsDescription: The framework is built on seven fundamental pillars that ensure comprehensive coverage of all critical aspects of your lakehouse architecture:
home.pillar1Desc: Ensure data brings value and supports business strategy through proper governance, cataloging, and metadata management.
home.pillar2Desc: Enable seamless interaction with users and systems through open standards and intuitive interfaces.
home.pillar3Desc: Maintain production systems efficiently with robust monitoring, automation, and incident management.
home.pillar4Desc: Protect data and systems from threats while meeting regulatory requirements and privacy standards.
home.pillar5Desc: Recover from failures and continue functioning through redundancy, backup strategies, and disaster recovery.
home.pillar6Desc: Optimize resource usage and adapt to changing demands with efficient data processing and query optimization.
home.pillar7Desc: Maximize business value while minimizing costs through resource right-sizing and usage optimization.
home.architectureDescription: Built on open standards and unified governance, the Databricks lakehouse architecture combines the best of data lakes and data warehouses:
home.architectureCaption: The lakehouse stack featuring Unity Catalog for unified governance, Delta Lake UniForm for open standards, and the Seven Pillars of the Well Architected Framework
home.cycleDescription: The WAF follows a structured continuous improvement approach to ensure your lakehouse architecture evolves with best practices and organizational needs:
home.cycleCaption: The continuous improvement cycle: Assess → Prioritize → Remediate → Educate → Automate, Monitor & Iterate
home.resourcesDescription: Access comprehensive lakehouse architecture documentation specific to your cloud platform:
home.awsDesc: Lakehouse Architecture on Amazon Web Services
home.gcpDesc: Lakehouse Architecture on Google Cloud Platform
home.ctaText: Begin your Well Architected Framework assessment and discover insights to optimize your Databricks lakehouse.
